source_response_generation: Synthetic source-complete q gate R~Bernoulli(logistic(alpha_stratum + 0.9*(cadence-0.65)/0.2 + beta_q*(q_true-0.04)/0.12)); every source has one latent q and one cadence, multi-native lower source pass intercept. No GPS tracks generated.
ecological_true_q_generation: For every simulated finite 109+11 source frame, q_source drawn iid Normal(mean=+0.04, SD=0.12), independent of cadence; positive truth is deliberately known, not inferred from public Movebank.
source_sampling: Within each world independent uniform random ordering within single- and multi-native metadata strata. Wave1 first 8/8, combined first 24/11. These *counterfactual* quotas are predefined for the synthetic demonstration, unlike real Wave2 quota chosen after Wave1 outcomes; never label real PR26 selection randomized.
measured_source_q: If R=1, observed q_source equals its synthetic latent q without added measurement error. This isolates source *availability* bias; real GPS observation can also bias measured q, which is not simulated here.
estimators: respondent_only_35_mean_by_109_11_source_stratum (undefined if any sampled stratum has no responders)
source_observation_Horvitz_Thompson_if_true_q_conditioned_probability_known (unimplementable oracle in real data, average over all worlds including zero responders)
source_observation_Horvitz_Thompson_if_only_cadence_and_stratum_probability_known_exactly_under_simulated_DGP (mechanistic negative control for MNAR, not an estimated propensity)
synthetic_marginal_response_probability_: Average sigmoid over 41 equally probability-spaced standard normal quantiles via Python statistics.NormalDist.inv_cdf; a synthetic oracle marginal P(R|cadence,stratum) that intentionally omits true source q.
no_reclassification: All real Wave1 and Wave2 original GPS q/covariance and source HOLDs, earlier 48-source shortwave external signed negative nonreplication, earlier ERA5 12 raw SHA source HOLD unchanged. Synthetic R is not true biology.
inferential_limits: Known truth is in a new arbitrary synthetic DGP; none of three logit coefficients or distribution parameters are estimated from real 35 sources; synthetic bias/coverage is not an externally validated model of true animal ecology. Outcome-linked source measurability is a sensitivity mechanism, not established causation.
